title: High Churn, High Revenue Customers
description: This cluster represents customers with a high likelihood of churning, indicated by a strong positive deviation in 'Churn Label_Yes' and 'Churn Value'. They also exhibit significantly higher 'Monthly Charges' and 'Total Charges' compared to the global average.  A notable absence of internet-related services like 'Tech Support', 'Streaming TV', 'Online Backup', and 'Online Security' further characterizes this group.

title: High Churn Risk: Fiber Optic Customers
description: This cluster represents customers with a significantly high propensity to churn. They are characterized by fiber optic internet service, month-to-month contracts, and a lack of online security and tech support.  These factors contribute to a higher churn score and monthly charges.

title: No Internet, Low Monthly Charges
description: This cluster represents customers with no internet service at all.  Consequently, they also lack various internet-dependent services like online security or streaming.  Their monthly charges are significantly lower than average.

title: Phone Service with DSL, No Extra Lines
description: This cluster represents customers who primarily use phone service without additional lines. They often subscribe to DSL internet. These customers tend to have lower monthly charges compared to the global average. The absence of features like multiple lines and fiber optic internet is a defining characteristic.
